title: Waymo Orders Thousands of Chinese Cars for US Robotaxi Fleet

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Legislators on Capitol Hill are raising national security alarms over the hardware Waymo is using for its self-driving operations. The company has ordered thousands of Chinese-made vehicles to expand its robotaxi fleet in the US, a move that has prompted concerns about the presence of foreign technology in American transportation infrastructure.

Critics allege that the import circumvents federal laws prohibiting the sale of vehicles that incorporate connected software sourced from China. Existing US regulations also restrict manufacturers with ties to Chinese entities from selling specific automobile models within the domestic market.
